method: Run in an rsync copy of the envoi/slice-15-release working tree without .env.local, with a cp -cR copy of node_modules and DATABASE_URL removed. Each definition in s15-landing-mutation-defs.json is applied alone by exact text replacement, every touched file restored and compared by SHA-256. Vitest definitions: the named row must fail on an AssertionError and the whole file pass on rerun; other failing rows are recorded. Command definitions: the command must exit non-zero with the needle in its output, the control command must pass under the same mutation, and the command must pass on rerun.
